name: promptwarden-vscode
description: Local, deterministic diagnostics for sensitive data (credit cards, IBANs, API keys, bulk PII) in open files — editor-side detection only, using the same policy engine as the browser extension and CLI. Cannot see or gate IDE inline-completion suggestions (Copilot, Cursor Tab, JetBrains AI) or the AI chat panel — that payload is assembled inside a closed process. See docs/IDE.md.

promptwarden.policyPath.markdownDescription: Path to a policy JSON file (validated with the same `parsePolicy` the CLI and browser extension use). Relative paths resolve against the first workspace folder. Empty uses the built-in default policy (`vscode-standalone-default`, the same profile as `promptwarden`'s CLI default). There is no managed-storage or `/etc` discovery here — set this explicitly, or use a VS Code Settings Sync / workspace `.vscode/settings.json` entry to distribute it.
